question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**effect**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Effect** means the **consequence** of certain factors.

 
 
• **Example: ***Drought is the **effect** of felling trees.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, "effect" is the appropriate option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Conclusion** - Ending.

 
 
• **Example: ***John **concluded** his story with a moral.*
 
 
 
• **Response** - Answer either written or verbal.
 
 
• **Example:** *Bob is not **responding** to my calls.*
 
 
 
• **Evidence** - supporting documents. 
 
 
• **Example:** *The lawyer provided **evidence** to strengthen his argument. *
